text:
Jules: Heads-up — thinking through routing policy config for tiers + regional fallbacks. Quick sketch:
Priya: sketch? drop it here pls.
Jules: idea: top-level policy per tenant -> inherit from plan (free/pro/enterprise) -> region overrides -> variant fallback list with weights. Example snippet:
Jules: ```
policy {
  plan: 'pro'
  region_overrides: { eu: { preferred: [gptx-le-1, gptx-s-1], fallback: [gptx-s-0] } }
  fallback_mode: 'strict' # strict | soft | additive
}
```
Tom: hmm 'fallback_mode' enums good. Need to define soft vs strict semantics. soft=allow lower-tier variant but emit telemetry? or permit extra cost?
Sasha: propose: strict = reject if no preferred available (HTTP 429), soft = route to fallback variant and tag telemetry, additive = try preferred then try fallbacks sequentially until budget/latency cutoffs. Need UX for console.
Alex: console: dropdown for plan inheritance + per-tenant exceptions. Also show 'simulated impact' panel that runs sample traffic and shows token cost delta.
Mara: product: +1 on simulated impact. Also need to surface 'quota enforcement' (soft/hard) and what it means for SLA/alerts.
Jules: telemetry: emit route.reason={preferred, fallback, region_mismatch} and quota.action={none, warned, throttled}. Also increment counters by tenant+region.
Priya: ops: make sure we don't double-bill tokens when fallback kicks in. Batching behavior can complicate attribution.
infra-bot: deploy-preview: routing-policy-service updated in canary with fallback_mode metric. CI: passed.
Tom: also need admin override API: POST /admin/tenants/{id}/policy/override with expiry.
Sasha: edge-case: multi-tenant shared GPUs — if capacity-constrained, prefer fallbacks that are cheaper but similar quality. How to express cost hints? maybe 'preference_score' or cost_multiplier.
Alex: UI request: add 'reason drilldown' in traces so PMs can see why fallback happened (region vs capacity vs quota).
Mara: next step: prod experiment — roll out soft fallback for a small cohort for 24h and check error/latency/cost impact. @Tom can you own rollout plan?
Tom: on it. Will draft canary + metrics (fallback_rate, token_delta, latency_p50/95) and post plan.
Jules: thanks everyone. filing a simple RFC PR with the policy json schema + console mockups. Assigning @Priya to review the schema.
Priya: ack. I'll review by EOD.
ops-bot: alert: tenant T-485 exceeded soft-fallback warning threshold (fallback_rate=6%) — creating incident draft.
Sasha: noted, pausing rollout to that segment.
Jules: updated RFC link: https://go/redwood/rfcs/1234
Mara: thanks — will sync in product sync later.
